record.question: Which of the following computer is used in hospitals like ECG and Dialysis?
record.explanation: ECG and dialysis equipment combine analog sensing/measurement with digital processing, hence the conventional “hybrid computer” answer. This is the conventional analog-input/digital-processing hybrid classification; modern individual medical devices can have different architectures. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://www.computerhistory.org/timeline/computers/; https://archive.computerhistory.org/resources/access/text/2024/04/102750051-05-0002-acc.pdf
